education.degree: M.S. in Computer Science (Quality & Reliability Focus)

employment.title: QA Engineer
employment.summary: Developed and maintained an end-to-end automation framework using Python, Playwright, and REST API validations, reducing UI regression time by ~45%; owned test coverage for booking and messaging workflows with 250+ automated test cases; partnered with SDEs/PMs on acceptance criteria and test strategy; built API contract and regression tests with pytest and Postman/Newman; integrated tests into CI pipelines (GitHub Actions/Jenkins) with reporting and gating rules; led defect triage (repro, logs/traces, high-quality bug reports).

employment.title: QA Engineer (Automation)
employment.summary: Implemented automation for model-serving APIs and internal evaluation pipelines using Python/pytest and TypeScript-based tooling; created smoke/regression/nightly suites to validate API reliability and latency/error handling; developed performance test scripts and monitoring checks (k6/JMeter-style); worked with engineering on quality metrics and flaky test reduction; conducted exploratory testing and automated coverage where feasible; maintained test environments/data fixtures and documented runbooks.

employment.title: QA Engineer (Associate)
employment.summary: Supported web/mobile projects with Selenium and API testing; helped establish basic QA processes (checklists, smoke test plans, release verification); wrote test cases and performed regression testing, documenting defects and verification steps.
